messages:
Samir K: heads up: PR #13421 is blocked by CI — intermittent failures in the `kv-store-integ` shard. failing ~50% of runs. link: https://git.company/pr/13421
Alex W: can you paste the failing log snippet?
Samir K: sure — this is the most common error we see:
```
E 2026-03-16T18:02:11Z kv-store: timeout waiting for batch ack (job=kv-store-integ, shard=3)
W 2026-03-16T18:02:11Z fallback: task retried 1/3
AssertionError: snapshot mismatch at line 423
```
Samir K: note: locally i can repro ~1/10 runs, so it's flaky, not a deterministic regression.
Maria P: that stack looks like the batching/timer race we fixed last month. are you running with `--batch-window=10ms` on the runner?
Samir K: CI uses the default runner config. i tried reproducing with `--batch-window=5ms` and got a failure once.
Lee N: @Maria P do you think it's safe to increase the batch timeout in CI for this suite? we can reduce flakes but that affects latency tests.
Maria P: i'd prefer a targeted change: bump for `kv-store-integ` only. add an env var in the job: `KV_BATCH_WINDOW_MS=25`. CI perf-sensitive suites stay the same.
Jordan H: we also need approvals pinned. @Lee N can you approve the PR after the green? it's got an infra tweak plus a small code cleanup.
Lee N: i can approve but want to avoid updating snapshots blindly. @Samir K can you attach the snapshot diff that CI shows when it fails?
Samir K: attaching minimal diff inline — only ~2 lines different in `kv_state.json`:
```diff
- "last_commit": 1023,
+ "last_commit": 1024,
- "cache_hits": 2048,
+ "cache_hits": 2047,
```
Samir K: seems like nondeterministic ordering changed counters. not a functional change.
Alex W: if the diff is only counters, we should avoid updating canonical snapshots. instead fix flake or make tests ignore volatile counters.
Maria P: agree. quick fix options: (1) make test normalize those fields before compare, (2) increase CI batch window, (3) retry flaky job automatically 2x on that shard.
Lee N: (1) sounds best long-term. do we have bandwidth for that before merge?
Samir K: i can do normalization in the test in a small follow-up patch today. if we need the PR unblocked now, i'd prefer (3) staged: retry 2x while i land the normalization in a follow-up.
CI Bot: rerun queued for job kv-store-integ (pr=13421) — attempt 1 of 2.
CI Bot: rerun result: PASS (kv-store-integ, shard=3) — 2106723575
Jordan H: looks green on the retried shard. @Lee N want me to request your formal approval now?
Lee N: please wait 15m — want to watch one more run. if it stays green i'll approve.
CI Bot: scheduled periodic rerun for kv-store-integ (pr=13421) in 10m — will post result.
Samir K: i'll open a follow-up PR with the test normalization and link it here. planning to keep this PR limited to the functional change + small infra env var if needed.
Alex W: plan sounds good. Samir, ping here when the follow-up is open and i'll re-run full CI.
Lee N: if follow-up lands quickly i'll approve this one after one more successful run. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Samir K: thanks — opening follow-up now: https://git.company/pr/13422 (test normalization).
CI Bot: periodic rerun result: PASS (kv-store-integ, shard=3) — 2106723805
Jordan H: with two green runs i'm comfortable requesting merge window. @Lee N last call for approval?
Lee N: approved. merging after 5m window.
Samir K: merged. thanks all. :rocket:
